relations.subject: Charles Henry Tawney
relations.evidence: he went to Trinity College, Cambridge, where he greatly distinguished himself. He was Bell University Scholar in 1857, and Davies University Scholar and Scholar of Trinity in the following year. In 1860 he was bracketed Senior Classic and was elected a Fellow of his college.

relations.subject: Charles Henry Tawney
relations.evidence: In 1860 he was bracketed Senior Classic and was elected a Fellow of his college. For the next four years he worked as a Fellow and Tutor at Trinity

relations.subject: Charles Henry Tawney
relations.evidence: In 1865 he was selected to occupy the Chair of History in the Presidency College, just then vacated by Professor E. Byles Cowell. Mr Tawney filled this Chair with great credit from 1866 to 1872

relations.subject: Charles Henry Tawney
relations.evidence: In 1875 he officiated as Principal in the place of Mr James Sutcliffe, and on the latter's death, in the following year, his position as Principal was confirmed. This office he held from 1876 to 1892

relations.subject: Charles Henry Tawney
relations.evidence: After his retirement from the Education service at the close of 1892 he was made Librarian of the India Office. He held this post till 1903, when he was superannuated.
